The C$12.1B quarterly decline had been driven by C$3.8B in negative market impact, primarily affecting low-fee AUM, and C$8.3B in net outflows, including C$5.2B from sub-advised assets.
Average quarterly AUM had totaled C$155.6B, down 4.1% Q/Q and 4.9% Y/Y.
The company had scheduled the release of its Q3 2026 financial results for the evening of Nov. 11, 2026.
